attacks.name: Absorbing Strike
steps: Before choosing a target, this character chooses whether this attack's type is |!physical| or |!energy|.
After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Sap Power|: Before |!damage| is dealt, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll, and this character gains that amount of |!power|.

attacks.name: Southern Hospitality
steps: After this attack is resolved, if the defender is |!size| 4 or less, this character may Throw it |!range_small|.

superPowers.name: Charge
superPowers.body: |*Action|: This character immediately makes a move action followed by an attack action. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Marvelous Strength
superPowers.body: Choose an interactive terrain feature of |!size| 4 or less and within |!range| 2 and Throw it |!range_medium|. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Mutant Absorption
superPowers.body: Choose an enemy character within |!range| 2 of this character. Roll 5 dice. The chosen character loses |!power| equal to the number of |!critical|, |!wild|, and |!hit| results. If the chosen character would lose more |!power| than it has, it suffers 1 |!damage| for each |!power| it could not lose. The chosen character does not gain |!power| for |!damage| suffered in this way. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Kree-Mutant Physiology
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
